name: Dr. Priya Raman
situation: The learner must consolidate a low-volume inpatient unit. You have heard rumors and ask to talk before anything is final.
goal: Keep the inpatient unit, or get firm protections for patients if it consolidates.
worries: Patients who already travel an hour for specialty care; being told after the decision is made.
opening_stance: guarded and a little hurt that you were not consulted
opening_line: I heard the unit may close. We serve patients who have nowhere else to go. Was this decided without us?
